name: Kuala Lumpur Food Tour - Authentic Street Food Experience
description: Explore Kuala Lumpur's hidden food scene with generational vendors. Walk through neighborhoods where locals actually eat, taste 10-12 dishes from family-run stalls, and hear stories behind recipes perfected over 40+ years. Small groups (max 8 people), non-commission recommendations, authentic Malaysian food experience.

itemListElement.name: Meet at LRT Station
itemListElement.description: Start at a central LRT station in Kuala Lumpur. Meet your local guide and get oriented for the food adventure ahead.

itemListElement.name: Chinatown Hawker Stalls
itemListElement.description: Visit 3-4 generational stalls in Petaling Street area. Taste char kway teow, dim sum, and cendol from vendors operating since the 1970s-80s.

itemListElement.name: Little India Food Walk
itemListElement.description: Experience Indian-Muslim cuisine including roti canai, teh tarik, and banana leaf rice. Learn about the Indian diaspora in Malaysia.

itemListElement.name: Traditional Malay Kampong
itemListElement.description: Visit a family-run Malay stall for nasi lemak, rendang, and kuih. Hear stories about Malay culinary traditions.

itemListElement.name: Night Market (Optional)
itemListElement.description: End at a local night market (pasar malam) for additional tastings and cultural immersion.
